muc.title: AI changed its style
muc.text: Yesterday AI answered one way, today another, for the exact same question. The company may have just changed the model version.

muc.title: Each version, a different brain
muc.text: A model version is a version of the AI's brain. A new one has learned more, so its tone and approach may change.

muc.title: The model name in the app
muc.text: Many apps show the model name at the top of the chat, and some let you pick the old version for a while.

muc.title: Save your go-to prompts
muc.text: Save the prompts you use often with sample results; when a new version comes out, rerun them to see what needs fixing.

muc.title: Note the model name
muc.text: Find out which model your chatbot is running and write its name with today's date in your notes.
